<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="4-man-aod-mechanics" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>4-Man AoD Mechanics</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/JChZfA1i4S.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This is a mechanics guide for 4-man Nex, Angel of Death. It is assumed that you know how to deal with mechanics in 7-man AoD, described in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Due to the meta heavily favouring ranged at the time of writing, this guide will assume that the team consists of </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Ranged Minion Tanks</nowiki></strong><nowiki>. The base can either Necro or Ranged.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The current rotations can </nowiki><strong><nowiki>consistently reaver skip</nowiki></strong><nowiki> if executed correctly.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="mechanics"><ins><nowiki>Mechanics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Dealing with mechanics in 4-man AoD is slightly different to how they are dealt with in 7-mans. The following summarizes the major mechanics of the fight and how to deal with them.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-1-3000000-2100000-hp"><nowiki>Phase 1 (3,000,000 - 2,100,000 HP)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Elements</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Quadrant with elements:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Tank it as you would in larger teams.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Quadrant with reavers:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Throw sticky bombs </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074306301964.png?v=1" alt="stickybomb" title="stickybomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at the reavers until AoD hits her phase hp.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Sticky bombs last 6s / 10t.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Before getting bound by consecutive sticky bombs, the reaver will always walk at least 1 tile.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: Fast teams should not need to tank elements and do not require sticky bombs as you should consistently reaver skip.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-2-2100000-1800000-hp"><nowiki>Phase 2 (2,100,000 - 1,800,000 HP)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Handle mechanics exactly the same as in Phase 1.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-3-1800000-600000-hp"><nowiki>Phase 3 (1,800,000 - 600,000 HP)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Smoke Pool</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• All tanked pools taken deal 14k damage spread evenly among the people inside.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Base is to tank the first pool making use of a vitality potion </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofvitality" title="powerburstofvitality" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. If the base is using ranged, the Fumus Minion Tank may instead handle the first pool with a vitality potion </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofvitality" title="powerburstofvitality" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If there are any other pools, they have to be tanked by at least 2 people both with &gt;7k hp.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ice</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Assist the team member who is trapped ice by doing damage on the ice to free them.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ All other mechanics work the same as in 7s.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="dummy-placement"><ins><nowiki>Dummy Placement</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Important Notes</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dummies </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1" alt="dummy" title="dummy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><strong><nowiki>CANNOT</nowiki></strong><nowiki> be placed during Nex's </nowiki><em><nowiki>elements</nowiki></em><nowiki> special attack since squares are blocked for placement</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Familiars </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1" alt="ripperpouch" title="ripperpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> block dummies, they are 2x2</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Conjures </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1" alt="conjurearmy" title="conjurearmy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> block dummies, they are 1x1</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Prisms </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/938475261366784070.png?v=1" alt="prismofrestoration" title="prismofrestoration" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1016651066684756070.png?v=1" alt="prismofloyalty" title="prismofloyalty" kind="icon" /><nowiki> block dummies</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Make sure before placing a dummy that nothing blocks it</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Call your familiars</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Move your conjures (Target the Glacies Amalgamation)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Don't place prisms near where dummies are supposed to be placed</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 128, 0)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>Dummy Placement
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>A total of 4 dummies can be placed with the following distribution:
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><div><div><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1236076241820450968.png?v=1" alt="fumusfrogy" title="fumusfrogy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> -  Fumus MT - Under Dummy
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>Place on the arena's central tile at any point before p3 (p2/3 is preferable if p1 damage is an issue)
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1236076207200669716.png?v=1" alt="cruorfrogy" title="cruorfrogy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - Cruor MT - West Dummy
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>Stand 2 squares out of md on the west midline and place before incend p3
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1236076295675183104.png?v=1" alt="umbrafrogy" title="umbrafrogy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - Umbra / Glacies MT - South-West Dummy
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>Place p1 from the tile shown, make sure no pets are blocking, can place after rapid p2 if blocked
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1236076486151372925.png?v=1" alt="basefrogy" title="basefrogy" kind="icon" /><nowiki>  -  Base - South Dummy
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>Place during p3 after the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1" alt="commandskeleton" title="commandskeleton" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, walk from southeast→south (blue rectangle) and place
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><span><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/tsGtkCpi5E.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></span><nowiki>

</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="minion-lure"><ins><nowiki>Minion Lure</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>To lure the minions using 3 minion tanks (UG Tank, C Tank and F Tank) players need to do the movement correctly.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ UG Tank will do the following:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at the Fumus detonation spot and move to the center line to avoid elements</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Move behind the umbra amalgamation (1) while targeting the amalgamation</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pre vuln umbra, and surge north after umbra spawns (to 2).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vuln glacies, and surge through nex to lure (to 3).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• After luring, you may move to the center line to be closer to first pillar (4).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ C Tank will do the following:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at the Umbra detonation spot and move to the center line to avoid elements</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Surge the minion through nex as you would in a 7-man team at the timing listed in rotations</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ F Tank will do the following:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at the Umbra detonation spot and move to the center line to avoid elements</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Surge the minion through nex as you would in a 7-man team at the timing listed in rotations</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Move back into after minion is fully lured</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/JUSNhrd8hm.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</nowiki><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>This guide is made and upkept in collaboration with the </nowiki>[https://discord.gg/2rd8Vqe <nowiki>Nex, Angel of Death discord</nowiki>]<nowiki>.

For those interested in a non-toxic and friendly environment for ‘Small’ team AoD, with team sizes varying from 4 to 7. We accept all experience levels, from Learners to Experts and Teachers. We offer teams running throughout the day.
